sql_evidence.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP VIEW op_stock AS SELECT * FROM (SELECT s.source_system,s.item_code,s.whs_code AS warehouse,p.inventory_uom_id,try_cast(s.on_hand AS DECIMAL(38,12)) AS on_hand_qty,try_cast(s.is_commited AS DECIMAL(38,12)) AS committed_qty,try_cast(s.on_hand AS DECIMAL(38,12))-try_cast(s.is_commited AS DECIMAL(38,12)) AS available_qty,s.source_as_of AS stock_as_of FROM (SELECT * FROM read_parquet('/media/issajar/DEVELOP/Projects/iMotorSoft/ai/lab/dataclient/telchi/staging/full-foundation-facts-succession-v1/stock-v1/inventory_balance.parquet')) s LEFT JOIN read_parquet('/media/issajar/DEVELOP/Projects/iMotorSoft/ai/lab/dataclient/telchi/reference/_versions/v2_sales_448ae93a960bf7342564a2d0/products/part-00000.parquet') p ON (p.source_system=s.source_system OR (p.source_system='SAP_HANA' AND s.source_system='SAP_B1_HANA')) AND p.item_code=s.item_code)

SELECT item_code,warehouse,inventory_uom_id AS unit,
            on_hand_qty,committed_qty,available_qty,stock_as_of
            FROM op_stock WHERE item_code=? ORDER BY warehouse
